full_judgment: 3. Suit was contested by defendant No. 1 stating amongst others that the land in suit and some other land belonged to Gopinath Gope and Tokani Gope; that Gopinath Gpe died leaving one son by name Monomohan Gope who on receiving 'salami' settled M7 acre of land by the patta dated 21 Aswin, 1352 B. S. to him; that he erected one 'chowchala' tin-shed but and 3 'dochala tin-shed huts and leaving there with the members of his family for the last 40 years and during S. A survey C. S plot No 217 was divided into three plots and is in possession of the land of plot No. 294; that as in connection with his service he was to stay away from Munshiganj the land was not recorded in his name in the S. A record and wrongly recorded in the name of Amdeka Khatutie, that in the revenue record by mistake it was noted that since 1964 he was in unlawful possession and he having objected to that same was struck off and 10 gandas of land has been recorded in his name; that he is possessing the land since 1964 on payment of tax, other dues and charges; that he objected to mutation of the name of the plaintiff; that he was never a tenant of the plaintiff and that Amdeka Khatun has never acquired any right, title and interest in the land possessed by him that while replying to the legal notice by mistake it was mentioned that Sailendra Chandra Bandapadhaya got the land from Gopinath Gope and others and he settled the land to defendants, father by Amalnama and granting receipt and on the death of his father by amicable arrangement with the brothers and sister he has got the land claimed by him; that his father had never taken settlement from Sailendra Chandra Bandapadhaya; that Amdeka Khatun sold 20 decimals of land in April, 1963 to Nurjahan Chowdhury, Begum Sufia Khatun and Musst. Lutfa Begurn and thereafter Musst. Lutfa Begum sold 10 decimal of land from plot Nos. 214 and 217 to Samsunnaharand thereafter Samsunnahar gifted 10 decimals of land in October, 1976 to Md. Abdul Malek.
